verdict.rationale: Anrok's product tax category (PTC) system determines taxability per jurisdiction for each product (docs-14, docs-26), and the AI Atlas feature explicitly surfaces reasoning grounded in the seller's own tax data (docs-15), matching the 'research visible' ask. However, there is no explicit documentation addressing bundled-offering taxability specifically, and no independent/hands-on evidence validating accuracy on genuinely hard SaaS-by-state or digital-goods edge cases. Missing for 10: bundled-offering taxability handling documentation, independent verification of correctness on hard cases, and richer per-determination research artifacts beyond the AI Atlas chat description.
